mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a temperature of 41 degrees and clear skies out at Badger Prairie County Park.

The City of Verona Parks and Recreation department is currently finalizing league schedules and standings for various sports, including adult volleyball at Sugar Creek Elementary, which is set to begin in November.

We have Yoga at Insight Wellness taking place today. Looking ahead, tomorrow is packed with options including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, along with live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee.
Looking at the weekly report, on October 21, Verona Police assisted fire and rescue services with a medical emergency at a business located in the 1000 block of Batker Court.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach, and the Culver's of Verona will open today at 10:00 AM.
